scoring_justification: Volumes are compared to hidden paper-reported values with tolerances and swelling factor consistency recomputed from the agent's volumes; barriers are checked against a threshold and a structural trend (n8 >= n16).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold unit-cell volumes (paper Fig 1) and acceptable ranges for swelling factors and barrier thresholds.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig 1 and text; barriers from statement 'barriers are 0.2-0.3 eV' and 'depend on n' (n8>=n16).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact reported volumes extracted; barrier range and trend derived from paper text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the paper's quantitative results.

outputs.description: Computed unit-cell volumes for the five LiNafion·nDMSO periodic structures.
NEB‑computed Li‑ion migration barriers for the n=8 and n=16 systems.

output_contract.notes: Volumes are compared to published reference values with a relative tolerance. Valid barriers must fall within the reported 0.2–0.3 eV window and satisfy n8 ≥ n16 (structural consistency).
